recognize_zh: 中央是一個玻璃樣變（hyalinized）、內含血管與樹突細胞的萎縮生發中心，外圍小淋巴球呈同心圓「洋蔥皮」（onion-skin）排列，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed (atretic) germinal center with pink hyalinized stroma and eosinophilic material
Germinal center composed largely of plump, elongated follicular dendritic/endothelial cells with vesicular nuclei rather than centroblasts
Broad mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin rings
Small vessels penetrating/around the follicle; a second small follicle with similar concentric layering at upper right
Interfollicular area of small lymphocytes with scattered small vessels; no sheets of plasma cells
describe_en: Lymph node section shows lymphoid follicles with regressed, hyalinized germinal centers composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells with pink hyaline stroma. The follicles are surrounded by expanded mantle zones in which small lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular region contains small lymphocytes and small vessels without a prominent plasma cell infiltrate or atypical large cells. Findings are consistent with hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell / multicentric Castleman disease (incl. HHV-8)
ddx.vs: Shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, often with hyperplastic rather than predominantly regressed follicles, and HHV-8 LANA-1 positive plasmablasts in the mantle in HHV-8 associated cases.

ddx.dx: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma arising in Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Forms sheets and fascicles of atypical spindle dendritic cells effacing the architecture rather than confined dysplastic dendritic cells within follicles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: The expanded mantle cells are monotonous, slightly irregular, and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas the concentric mantle here is polyclonal and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with regressed follicles (e.g., HIV, autoimmune)
ddx.vs: Regressed follicles are usually admixed with hyperplastic germinal centers and lack the widespread onion-skinning with lollipop vessels.
